name: complex_literal_default_mode
source:
{ An imaginary literal in a document solved with DEFAULT settings — complex mode
  is a solver flag, not a document directive, so this records what the engine
  does with `4i` when the flag is off. Whatever that is, both engines must agree. }
z = 3 + 4i
w = 1j * z

error.message: The equations contain complex literals (e.g. 1i): enable Complex mode to solve them.
